```{python}
import polarstation as ps
import polars as pl
```

```{python}
penguins = pl.read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allisonhorst/palmerpenguins/main/inst/extdata/penguins.csv", null_values = "NA")
penguins
```

```{python}
(penguins
  .ps.with_columns(
    width = pl.col('bill_length_mm').ps_chop.width(10),
    n_elements = pl.col('bill_length_mm').ps_chop.n_elements(50, fmt="1.0f"),
    n_groups_a = pl.col('bill_length_mm').ps_chop.n_groups(5, return_struct=False),
    n_groups = pl.col('bill_length_mm').ps_chop.n_groups(5,return_struct=True),
    quantiles = pl.col('bill_length_mm').ps_chop.quantiles(probs = [0.2, 0.6]),
    chop = pl.col('bill_length_mm').ps_chop.chop(breaks=[35, 40, 50]),
  )
)
```


```{python}
(penguins
  .group_by('species')
  .agg(pl.col('body_mass_g').std())
)

```



```{python}
pl.Series('x', values = ['a', 'b', 'c']).cast(pl.Enum(categories = ['a', 'b', 'c', None]))
```


 
 ```{python}
n = 1_000_000_000

lf = (
    pl.select(
        pl.int_range(0, n).alias("id")
    )
    .lazy()
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("id") * 2).alias("x"),
        (pl.col("id") % 100).cast(pl.String).alias("group"),
    )
)

lf.head().collect()
 ```

```{python}
(lf.ps.with_columns(
    pl.col('group').ps_enum.make()
      .ps_enum.reorder(by = 'x', agg = pl.Expr.mean, descending=True)
      .ps_enum.
  )
  .head()
  .collect()
  .get_column('group')
  .dtype
)
```


```{python}
import catfact as fct
(penguins
  .with_columns(
    pl.col('species').cast(pl.Categorical)
  )
  .with_columns(
    tmp = fct.infreq(pl.col('species'))
  )
)
```
